guide.heading: Merge Sort Guide
guide.splitting: Split the array recursively into two halves.
guide.keep-splitting: Keep splitting until each part has at most 2 elements.
guide.merge: Merge the subarrays from left to right.

hint.odd: If splitting an odd array, the left subarray will have one more element.
hint.ignore: Elements not in the current subarray can be ignored.

guide.heading: Quick Sort Guide
guide.choose: Choose last element {{lastElement}} as pivot element.
guide.after-partition:
After partitioning, all elements smaller than {{pivot}} are on its left, and larger on the right. Choose {{nextPivot}} as next pivot element.
The used pivot element {{pivot}} is marked.
guide.end:
The used pivot element {{pivot}} is marked
Sorting is complete!

guide.heading: Bubble Sort Guide
guide.goThroughArray: Go through the array, one element at a time.
guide.swap: Swap, if the left element is bigger than the next one.
guide.hint: Skip steps where no elements are swapped.

guide.heading: Selection Sort Guide
guide.start:
Starts with the current element at index 0.
Find the smallest from the remaining elements.
guide.swap:
Swap current ({{currentElement}}) with smallest ({{smallestElement}}).
Move to index {{move}} and find the smallest in the unsorted subarray.
